termsText:
To use EduIDE we process a limited amount of personal data: your login details, your session and workspace information, and anonymous crash reports. Data stays within TUM infrastructure and is not passed on to third parties.

The full details are set out in our data protection statement, which opens in a new tab.
acceptTerms: I have read the data protection statement and agree to the processing of my data
acceptTermsHelp: You need to agree before you can use EduIDE.
termsAcceptanceRequired: Please confirm that you have read the data protection statement.
